title: Nepal–Tibet Border Flash Floods Tracker Update — Oct 16, 2026
summary: Nepal Police figures as of 14 October put confirmed dead at 1,456 and missing at 5,132. The 40-day search phase has ended and the government has shifted to rehabilitation, with a cabinet-level meeting recommending NPR 559.17 billion for 504 reconstruction plans. No new events were found for the past week.
